answer: Require every agent identity to prove unique compute before joining: each identity must complete a verifiable delay function bound to a hardware attestation, so one machine cannot mint many identities in parallel. Like water carving a karst cave, the cost accumulates slowly and cannot be rushed; a Sybil operator trying to wander through the registry with a plume of fake accounts must pay real compute per identity, and identities that stop doing verifiable work decay and lose standing. Forging a thousand agents then costs a thousand machines' worth of time, while honest agents pay only one.
